families.name: Complementary capability formation
families.statement: Realized capability is often co-produced by components, infrastructure, skills, process and institutions; resolving one bottleneck can move the governing bottleneck.

families.name: Staged realization and validation
families.statement: Discovery, validation, production, deployment, diffusion, durability and evaluator standing are separable; transitions require stage-appropriate evidence/complements/continuity.

families.name: Observability expands the reachable question space
families.statement: Instruments, measurements and evidence infrastructure can change which hypotheses are discriminable and future search cost/adjacency.

families.name: Representations and standards as coordination substrates
families.statement: Representation is not reality, yet shared standards/interfaces/notations can causally coordinate distributed actors and enable complements.

families.name: Scale-induced boundary dynamics
families.statement: Scaling can move bottlenecks, expose new causal/value dimensions and create externalities, changing the relevant problem boundary.

families.name: Distributed causation and historical attribution
families.statement: Innovation trajectories are frequently multi-actor/multi-stage; inventor/date narratives can compress causal contribution.

families.name: Objective-relative frontier choice
families.statement: Local value, generality, option value, metaproductivity and time-to-effect are separable; choice depends on objective, horizon, risk and bottleneck.

nonClaims: No mandatory centralized process or fixed stage order follows.
Recurrence does not grant implementation authority.
Bounded 320-trajectory synthesis, not population estimate of all history.
